verdict.rationale: Svelte's core value proposition is single-file components combining markup, styles, and logic using standard HTML/CSS/JS, with scoped CSS and a compiler that turns declarative components into optimized JS; docs and community feedback (readable generated code, ease of use) corroborate this. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on demonstration of a single .svelte file's exact syntax in the evidence, only descriptive doc claims.
